title: FBI-UAP-PR001, “Triangle Orbs,” Northeastern United States, 2021
what_is_it: A metadata record for an FBI-held video (VID) exhibit showing an unidentified aerial phenomenon, released as part of the war.gov/UFO/ PURSUE collection.
interpretation_warnings: Single-source account: all observational detail comes from one eyewitness, not independent sensors or corroborating witnesses.
The FBI's 'highly credible' label is an assessment of the witness, not verification that the object was anomalous.
Estimates of distance (2,000 feet) and altitude are witness approximations, not instrument measurements.
Hand-held iPhone recording introduced 'unintended camera movement', which can distort perceived motion of lights.
The PDF itself yielded no extractable text; this summary rests almost entirely on the war.gov CSV description and metadata.
A low-light 0500 observation of point-like lights is prone to misidentification of conventional aircraft, drones, or astronomical sources.

key_facts.source_quote: In November 2021, at approximately 0500 local time in the northeastern United States
